newsitem.title: BELGIUM: UPE to grudgingly back Gil-Robles.
newsitem.headline: UPE to grudgingly back Gil-Robles.

text.p: The European Parliament's third biggest group -- the Union for Europe -- said on Thursday it would back the election of European People's Party (EPP) deputy Jose Gil-Robles Gil Delgado as parliamentary president next Tuesday.
But the group denounced the way the selection had been made, and the carve-up of the parliamentary bureau and questors between the two biggest groups, the Socialists and EPP.
It said the carve-up did not take account of all the political forces in the European Union and left the less populated nations without any representation on the pivotal parliamentary bodies.

In protest at the sharing out of the five posts of questors -- who act as internal parliamentary watchdogs -- between the two groups, the UPE will propose Ireland's Mark Killilea for one of the spots, it said in a statement.
